Department of Local Government  - Eastern Province
Eastern Provincial Councils Notification Standard by Law.
reasoning: This gazette content establishes regulatory requirements and licensing procedures for money-lending businesses within the Eastern Province Pradeshiya Sabha jurisdictions. It creates a legal framework for business operations, specifies application procedures, sets compliance requirements, and references existing legislation. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification as it deals with regulatory frameworks and statutory instruments rather than government personnel/structure, land matters, commercial registrations, or other specialized categories.
